response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architectural and DevOps exposure, but his seniority level (Staff/Senior roles for over a decade) far exceeds the junior/mid-level requirement, and his German language skill is only basic despite high on-site presence being required.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack and DevOps skills including Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure
Demonstrated ability to build scalable platforms and contribute to open-source projects
concerns: Significantly overqualified with 10+ years of senior-level experience for an entry-level role
Basic German proficiency may hinder on-site collaboration in Berlin
History of founding/startup roles suggests potential misalignment with structured team environments
